title: Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce's Private Wedding Ceremony
summary: Singer Taylor Swift and NFL player Travis Kelce have reportedly tied the knot in a private ceremony. The exact details of their wedding vows are not publicly known, but it is reported that the ceremony took place at Madison Square Garden. Celebrities were spotted arriving at the venue, suggesting a high-profile event. The union between Swift and Kelce has generated significant media attention.
